map.角膜映光法(Hirschberg test)判断眼位偏斜方向与角度，筛查儿童斜视: Hirschberg (corneal light reflex) test judges deviation direction/angle to screen pediatric strabismus
map.提示：Hirschberg法是粗略筛查，精确角度需用三棱镜+交替遮盖法。光反射偏: Note: Hirschberg is a rough screen; exact angle needs prism + alternate cover test. Reflex toward nose = exotropia (outward turn); toward temple = esotropia (inward turn). Pediatric strabismus needs early detection/treatment; 3-6 years is the key window for amblyopia therapy. Types to rule out: congenital (within 6 months), accommodative esotropia (from hyperopia), intermittent exotropia. All strabismus children need cycloplegic refraction. This tool is for screening reference only.
map.光反射偏位 2mm×15°/mm=30°；偏颞侧→内斜视、偏鼻侧→外斜视(中度): Reflex offset 2 mm ×15°/mm = 30°; toward temple -> esotropia, toward nose -> exotropia (moderate).
map.偏移<1.5mm(<22.5°)→轻度，可观察或视光训练。: Offset <1.5 mm (<22.5°) -> mild, observe or optometric training.
map.角膜直径约 11mm 对应 22.5°，每 mm 偏移≈15°偏斜的粗略估算。: Corneal diameter ~11 mm corresponds to 22.5°; each mm offset ≈15° deviation, a rough estimate.
map.Hirschberg 为筛查，精确角度靠棱镜遮盖/同视机。: Hirschberg is screening; exact angle relies on prism-cover/synoptophore.
map.视力(Hirschberg)眼位评估器，通过角膜映光法判断眼位偏斜方向与程度，筛: The Hirschberg eye-alignment assessor judges deviation direction/degree by corneal light reflex to screen strabismus. A medical professional tool based on authoritative standards, for reference only.
